steps.title: Drum and shaft condition
steps.body: Sound drum and shaft generally favour refurbishment. Significant wear or cracking favours replacement.

steps.title: Brakes and hydraulics
steps.body: Both are renewable. Long-term hydraulic contamination indicates wider wear.

steps.title: Capability
steps.body: Additional depth, load or control can often be achieved by upgrade during the rebuild.

steps.title: Spares availability
steps.body: Obsolete control systems are the most common cost driver; replacement controls can be included in the rebuild.

steps.title: Class status
steps.body: Timing the rebuild with a renewal survey reduces cost and downtime.

steps.title: Required service life
steps.body: Match the rebuild to the vessel's remaining life.
